# Flow models

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from the model cards; do not edit. -->

43 flow models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: two RGB images (consecutive frames). Output: per-pixel motion from the first to the second (dx, dy in pixels).

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130; `fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW` measures yours. The summary uses one input, 1080x1920: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under `torch.compile` and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable ([export](../export.md); memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured. The accuracy column is lower-is-better (KITTI 2015 train EPE (px)).

Other devices: [Apple M1 Pro 16 GB](../devices/apple-m1-pro-16gb.md), [NVIDIA L4](../devices/l4-22gb.md), [NVIDIA L40S](../devices/l40s-44gb.md), [NVIDIA A10](../devices/a10-22gb.md), [NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB](../devices/a100-sxm4-40gb.md), [NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000](../devices/rtx-pro-6000-96gb.md); [across devices](../benchmarks.md#other-devices).

## FlowFormer Small

FlowFormer Small (ECCV 2022): convolutional features and a latent cost-memory transformer for optical flow. Apache-2.0 code; the authors provide no separate checkpoint licence.

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `flowformer-small-chairs` | synthetic (375x1242) | original (fp32)<br>original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 352<br>303<br>351<br>–<br>250<br>202 | 3122 / 3718<br>2382 / 2970<br>3165 / 3638<br>–<br>2438 / 3196<br>2087 / 2138 |
| `flowformer-small-things` | synthetic (375x1242) | original (fp32)<br>original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 352<br>303<br>351<br>–<br>250<br>202 | 3122 / 3678<br>2382 / 3010<br>3165 / 3638<br>–<br>2438 / 3196<br>2087 / 2138 |
| `flowformer-small-sintel` | synthetic (375x1242) | original (fp32)<br>original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 352<br>303<br>351<br>–<br>250<br>202 | 3122 / 3718<br>2382 / 2990<br>3165 / 3638<br>–<br>2438 / 3196<br>2087 / 2138 |

### Measured

Frames _10 -> _11 at full size against the flow_occ ground truth; EPE = mean of the per-pair mean end-point error, Fl-all = share of all valid pixels with an error > 3 px and > 5 % of the GT magnitude. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

| variant | dataset | original fp32 | original fp16 | portable | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `flowformer-small-chairs` | KITTI 2015 train, EPE / Fl-all % | 10.952 / 36.72 | 11.102 / 36.80 | 10.952 / 36.72 |  |
| `flowformer-small-things` | KITTI 2015 train, EPE / Fl-all % | 6.884 / 17.92 | 7.034 / 17.91 | 6.884 / 17.92 |  |
| `flowformer-small-sintel` | KITTI 2015 train, EPE / Fl-all % | 4.657 / 6.35 | 4.206 / 6.30 | 4.657 / 6.35 | trained on this dataset's public images; not a zero-shot result |

Measured on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130, fastforks a6ea0725+dirty, 2026-11-11.

### Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.0001 vs the original. GPU, portable float32 and kernels float16 (the defaults): mean |diff| <= 0.0021 and p99 <= 0.013 (absolute error of the output `flow`).

| variant | kernels error vs original, mean / p99 | GPU, torch | kernels used |
|---|---|---|---|
| `flowformer-small-chairs` | no kernels backend | - | - |
| `flowformer-small-things` | no kernels backend | - | - |
| `flowformer-small-sintel` | no kernels backend | - | - |

### Limitations

- Only the Small architecture is included.
- No custom kernels backend is implemented.
- Full-frame cost memory grows quadratically with input area; upstream tiled evaluation is not included. Full-frame 1080p exceeded the RTX 5060 Ti 16GB memory in portable and original fp32/fp16 runs.

</details>

## FlowSeek

FlowSeek (University of Bologna, 2025), size T: SEA-RAFT optical flow that also uses a frozen Depth Anything V2 Small: its features help the matching and its depth tells which flow a camera motion would cause. Apache-2.0 code; the authors' weights carry no separate licence.

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `flowseek-t` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original (fp32)<br>original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 650<br>457<br>395<br>–<br>258<br>168 | 9902 / 10052<br>8693 / 9880<br>8671 / 8712<br>–<br>6126 / 6212<br>11328 / 11350 |
| `flowseek-t-things` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original (fp32)<br>original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 650<br>458<br>395<br>–<br>258<br>168 | 9902 / 10012<br>8693 / 9820<br>8671 / 8712<br>–<br>6126 / 6212<br>11330 / 11352 |
| `flowseek-t-things-notartan` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original (fp32)<br>original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 651<br>458<br>396<br>–<br>258<br>168 | 9902 / 10052<br>8693 / 9820<br>8671 / 8712<br>–<br>6126 / 6212<br>11328 / 11350 |

## GMFlow

GMFlow (2022; the flow models of UniMatch, 2023): optical flow as one global matching step between Transformer-enhanced features of both images; variants add a second matching scale and refinement steps. MIT code; the authors' weights carry no separate licence.

Commercial use: yes.

MemFlow (Dong and Fu, CVPR 2024): optical flow with a motion memory, a RAFT-style network whose update step also reads attention over the frame's motion features. Apache-2.0 code and weights; some training sets are research-only.

Commercial use: yes.

## MEMFOF

<a id="waft"></a>

## WAFT

WAFT a1 (Princeton, 2025): optical flow without a cost volume. Each step warps the second image's features by the current flow and a small vision transformer refines it; uses a frozen Depth Anything V2 Small. BSD-3-Clause code; the authors' weights carry no separate licence.

Commercial use: yes.

Speed and memory not measured for: `waft-a1`, `waft-a1-kitti`, `waft-a1-sintel`.

<details><summary>Details</summary>

- Paper: [WAFT: Warping-Alone Field Transforms for Optical Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.21526), arXiv, 2025-06-26
- Original code: <https://github.com/princeton-vl/WAFT> at `b152ff1cad1a`
- Code licence: BSD-3-Clause (permissive); files: `LICENSE`
- Weights licence: BSD-3-Clause (assumed from code)
- Licence evidence: <https://github.com/princeton-vl/WAFT/blob/b152ff1cad1af8c185ee7b141997c48ff3334c87/README.md#model-zoo>
- Training data: TartanAir, FlyingChairs (Freiburg), Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa) (TartanAir pretraining, FlyingChairs, then FlyingThings3D (part of SceneFlow), as the checkpoint name tar-c-t says; the Depth Anything V2 Small inside was trained by its authors on synthetic and pseudo-labelled real images)
  - `waft-a1-kitti`: TartanAir, FlyingChairs (Freiburg), Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), MPI Sintel optical flow, KITTI stereo / optical flow 2012 / 2015, HCI HD1K optical flow benchmark (TartanAir, FlyingChairs, FlyingThings3D, then fine-tuned on KITTI 2015 (5000 steps; the config does not name the starting checkpoint, counted as the TSKH stage as in SEA-RAFT))
  - `waft-a1-sintel`: TartanAir, FlyingChairs (Freiburg), Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), MPI Sintel optical flow, KITTI stereo / optical flow 2012 / 2015, HCI HD1K optical flow benchmark (TartanAir, FlyingChairs, FlyingThings3D, then the mix of FlyingThings3D, Sintel, KITTI 2015 and HD1K (TSKH))
- Options: `iters` = 5 (>= 1)
- Kernel libraries: none (no kernels mode was built for it; Depth Anything's fast ViT kernels would fit)
- Variants: `waft-a1`, `waft-a1-kitti`, `waft-a1-sintel`
- Outputs: flow
- Input size: any H x W >= 112, resized or padded inside the model
- Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): `waft-a1` not measured yet; `waft-a1-kitti` not measured yet; `waft-a1-sintel` not measured yet

## Training datasets

| id | dataset | licence | commercial use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sceneflow` | [Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa)](https://lmb.informatik.uni-freiburg.de/resources/datasets/SceneFlowDatasets.en.html) | LicenseRef-research-only | no |
| `kitti` | [KITTI stereo / optical flow 2012 / 2015](https://www.cvlibs.net/datasets/kitti/) | CC-BY-NC-SA-3.0 | no |
| `tartanair` | [TartanAir](https://theairlab.org/tartanair-dataset/) | CC-BY-4.0 | yes |
| `flyingchairs` | [FlyingChairs (Freiburg)](https://lmb.informatik.uni-freiburg.de/resources/datasets/FlyingChairs.en.html) | LicenseRef-research-only | no |
| `sintel-flow` | [MPI Sintel optical flow](https://sintel.is.tue.mpg.de/license) | LicenseRef-noncommercial | no |
| `hd1k` | [HCI HD1K optical flow benchmark](https://hci-benchmark.iwr.uni-heidelberg.de/) | not stated | unclear |
| `spring` | [Spring (scene flow / optical flow / stereo, University of Stuttgart)](https://spring-benchmark.org/) | CC-BY-4.0 | yes |
